resources.string: Waiting for Apple iPhone or Android device…
Device disconnected. Connect your Apple or Android phone.
Connect your iPhone via USB cable or wireless adapter to launch Apple CarPlay with Waze, Apple Music, and handsfree calls. Tap for guide.
Connect any Android phone (Samsung, Xiaomi, Pixel, etc.) via USB cable. Android Auto and Aura AI launch automatically. Tap for guide.
Step-by-step instructions for Apple iOS and Android devices

🔌 Direct USB Cable Connection:
1. Connect iPhone directly to vehicle USB port or adapter using a quality data cable.
2. Tap 'Trust This Computer' or 'Allow CarPlay' on your iPhone.
3. CarTwin immediately starts Apple CarPlay video and audio.

📡 Wireless Connection (Cable-free):
1. Enable Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on iPhone.
2. Pair with 'CarTwin' from Bluetooth settings.
3. Tap 'Use Wireless CarPlay' on your phone.

💡 Note: Siri must be enabled in iPhone Settings ➔ Siri & Search.
🤖 2. Android Phone (Samsung, Xiaomi, Pixel, Honor, etc.)

🔌 Direct USB Cable Connection (AOA 2.0):
1. Connect phone directly to vehicle USB port with a quality data cable.
2. In the phone USB notification, select 'Android Auto / File Transfer'.
3. CarTwin identifies your phone model (Samsung, Xiaomi, Pixel, etc.) via AOA 2.0 and launches Android Auto.

📡 Wireless Connection (Cable-free):
1. Turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on your phone.
2. Pair with 'CarTwin' in Bluetooth settings.
3. Confirm 'Allow Wireless Android Auto'.

🎙️ Aura AI Assistant: Works for hands-free vehicle climate, navigation, and music control.

⚠️ Cable plugged in but no reaction?
• Ensure the cable is a data cable (not charge-only) and 'Android Auto / File Transfer' is selected.
• If vehicle screen prompts for USB permission, select 'Always Allow'.

🔄 Connection dropped?
• Tap 'Restart Services' button on the screen.

🎙️ How does Aura AI work?
• Press steering wheel voice button or tap brand logo to speak in English, Azerbaijani, Turkish, or Russian.
I am Aura AI — your personal vehicle assistant. Ready for your command.
